top_categories.workout_context: 62 miles on rolling coastal burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Pedal IMUA's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before December.
67ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Pedal IMUA's rolling coastal forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 62 miles.
At Pedal IMUA, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Base fitness for Pedal IMUA. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Pedal IMUA. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on rolling coastal demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
When someone attacks on rolling coastal, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
The aerobic base that lets you ride rolling coastal at tempo for 62 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Low-cadence force work for 4,173ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Pedal IMUA, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.

race_overlay.heat: December in Kahului, Maui, Hawaii, USA — Tropical Maui in December: warm and humid with trade winds; exposed coastal sections and rain showers possible on the windward north side. Begin heat acclimatization 10–14 days before Pedal IMUA — 20–30min sauna sessions or midday rides in full kit. Pre-load sodium 48 hours out. Target 500–750ml/hr with electrolytes on race day. Race-day realities: Humidity and sun exposure on the coastal sections.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Pedal IMUA’s 62 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Pedal IMUA requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling coastal to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 62 miles of rolling coastal in Kahului, Maui, Hawaii, USA.
